summary: cypress-realworld-app is the corpus's first LIVE-backend, stateful vertical. All 14 existing WITNESS_REAL_APP_NAMES apps are backend:'none', single static origin, and the generic parser (witness-real-app.ts) hard-requires servedStatic.byteIdentical===true (L799) and pass-1==pass-2 semanticDigest determinism (L948-950). The required money-movement journey mutates lowdb database.json (new tx id/timestamps), breaking replay determinism, and needs a real Express backend on a second loopback port — a serving model the harness lacks (startStaticServer only offers an in-context 'api' stub the goal forbids). Infra IS present (both lane builds, installed backend, chromium, source). Blocked on unresolved architecture + over-scope (schema+16 live runs+700-line schema+green gate exceeds 40min); made no edits to keep the tree clean.
open_questions: Second loopback origin accounting: run the REAL Express+lowdb backend on a separate 127.0.0.1 port and add a same-machine-loopback request category, or reject that and require a different model? successfulNonLoopback must stay 0 — is a second loopback origin 'same-origin loopback' or a new admitted category the schema must define?

Deterministic replay-twice-identical vs a mutating backend: the parser throws 'repeated pass differs' unless pass-1 and pass-2 semanticDigests match, but the money-movement flow mutates database.json. Contract needed: re-seed from data/database-seed.json before each pass AND normalize minted transaction ids/timestamps to placeholders (hospitalrun's {created-patient-id} idiom) so both passes agree — confirm exact normalization surface.

servedStatic.byteIdentical scope: confirm byteIdentical/static-inventory applies only to the frontend SPA dist bytes (which stay identical) while backend lowdb state is explicitly outside the byte inventory — this needs a schema extension since the generic WitnessRealAppRun models one static origin.

Scope/cut: this unit (new live-backend harness path + WITNESS_REAL_APP_NAMES entry + dedicated runner + 16 real browser runs against a mutating backend + ~700-line witness-react-cypress-rwa.ts schema + tests + green tsc/lint/node gate) exceeds 40min. Recommend the packet's own suggested cut: Unit A = harness live-backend serving path + AppSpec journey spec + schema shape (no full evidence); Unit B = runner + publish real 16-run artifacts under evidence/runs/react-cypress-rwa. Approve this split or re-scope?
